abstract: Perfect equilibrium and its refinements are widely studied and typically rely on full-support perturbations. We introduce a δ-localized notion of perfection for games with a continuum of players. It confines perturbations within a δ-neighborhood of the underlying action distribution and eliminates undesirable equilibria from a local perspective. We establish the existence of a pure strategy δ-localized perfect equilibrium and show that it is equivalent to δ-admissible Nash equilibrium. We also study limit versions of δ-localized perfection. Illustrative applications to large routing games and crowd saturation games are presented.
abstract_zh: 完美均衡及其精炼已被广泛研究，通常依赖于全支撑扰动。我们针对具有连续统参与者的博弈引入了一种δ-局部化的完美概念。它将扰动限制在基础行动分布的δ-邻域内，并从局部视角消除不良均衡。我们证明了纯策略δ-局部化完美均衡的存在性，并表明其等价于δ-可容许纳什均衡。我们还研究了δ-局部化完美的极限版本。文中给出了在大规模路由博弈和人群饱和博弈中的示例性应用。
title: Localized perfection

abstract: We document the role of premarket human capital in explaining racial and ethnic income disparities in labor market outcomes for individuals from their late 20s to mid-50s. Using comprehensive measures of the human capital students possess at the end of high school—including scores on achievement tests in reading comprehension, vocabulary, and math, GPA—and detailed school context measures, we study Black-White and Hispanic-White gaps across various economic outcomes. We find that human capital at high school completion largely determines racial and ethnic differences in mid-life labor market outcomes, explaining up to 87% of gaps in some outcomes. Our analysis examines men and women separately to provide a comprehensive picture of how human capital relates to racial and ethnic disparities across genders. We find that human capital explains a larger proportion of Black-White income gaps for women (95%) than men (69%), with women’s racial gaps primarily explained by test scores while men’s gaps show greater contributions from educational attainment and school characteristics. Finally, we show that the Black-White income gap for this cohort widened from early career to mid-life, with the explanatory power of human capital increasing as people grew older. Our research extends previous literature by considering longer-term outcomes, employing comprehensive and refined human capital measures, and broadening the scope of racial and ethnic comparisons. These findings emphasize the critical and persistent role of human capital development in shaping long-term economic outcomes and racial and ethnic disparities, reinforcing the need for targeted educational interventions to address persistent inequalities across the life course.
title: Human capital and racial and ethnic gaps in mid-life labor market outcomes: Evidence from High School and Beyond 1980
title_zh: 人力资本与中年劳动力市场结果中的种族和族裔差距：来自1980年高中及以后的证据

abstract: In a coordination game with multiple Pareto ordered equilibria and population uncertainty, we show that group size helps select a unique equilibrium, for reasons reminiscent of the global games literature. A critical mass phenomenon emerges at equilibrium. Group size has an emboldening effect on participants.
abstract_zh: 在具有多个帕累托排序均衡和人口不确定性的协调博弈中，我们证明群体规模有助于选择唯一均衡，其原因与全球博弈文献中的观点相似。均衡中出现了一个关键多数现象。群体规模对参与者具有鼓舞效应。
title: Group size as selection device
title_zh: 群体规模作为选择机制

abstract: The efforts made by states to curb wildlife poaching increasingly involve the deployment of military forces, especially in countries of the Global South. This shift towards a “war on poachers” can include measures such as shoot-on-sight policies, raising concerns about civil and human rights. While previous research has emphasized the perspectives of local communities, law enforcement, or hunters, to the best of our knowledge little is known about broader public support—an important factor for policy legitimacy and effectiveness. In this article, we examine public attitudes towards: (a) private and public protected areas managed by the military, (b) stronger criminal sanctions against poaching, and (c) granting expanded authority to the military to combat poaching. Using original national surveys from India, Indonesia, and South Africa—countries that have implemented aspects of militarized conservation—we found generally positive attitudes for military management of protected areas. In India and Indonesia, however, respondents still preferred non-military management when given a direct comparison. Across all three samples, people tended to support increasing military powers, particularly against commercial poaching. Respondents also favored maintaining or strengthening punishments for poachers. We conclude by identifying avenues for future research into the drivers of public support for militarized conservation.
abstract_zh: 各国为遏制野生动物偷猎所作的努力日益涉及部署军事力量，尤其是在全球南方国家。这种向“对偷猎者宣战”的转变可能包括“见即射杀”政策等措施，引发了对公民权利和人权的担忧。尽管以往研究侧重于当地社区、执法部门或猎人的视角，但据我们所知，关于更广泛公众支持——这一对政策合法性和有效性至关重要的因素——的了解仍然有限。在本文中，我们考察了公众对以下方面的态度：（a）由军方管理的私人和公共保护区，（b）对偷猎行为实施更严厉的刑事制裁，以及（c）授予军方更大权力以打击偷猎。利用来自印度、印度尼西亚和南非的原创全国性调查——这些国家已实施军事化保护的相关措施——我们发现，公众普遍对军方管理保护区持积极态度。然而，在印度和印度尼西亚，当直接比较时，受访者仍倾向于非军事管理。在所有三个样本中，人们倾向于支持扩大军方权力，尤其是针对商业偷猎。受访者还赞成维持或加强对偷猎者的惩罚。最后，我们指出了未来研究公众对军事化保护支持驱动因素的方向。
title: Public support for military conservation: Understanding public opinion to the ‘war on poachers’ in three countries
title_zh: 公众对军事化保护的支持：理解三国公众对“反偷猎战争”的态度

abstract: We develop a search-based theory of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) with heterogeneous firms and endogenous search complementarities. We use this model to study how merger incentives, endogenous innovation, and the firm size distribution interact. We derive the law of motion of the firm size distribution, provide closed-form solutions, and solve for firms’ investment in internal innovation and external acquisitions. Strategic complementarities in acquisition incentives can generate multiple equilibria, including an unstable equilibrium with high M&A activity. The model therefore offers a new perspective on merger waves as episodes in which favorable fundamentals and coordination interact to generate temporary bursts of acquisition activity. Competition policy can affect both the level of equilibrium merger activity and the set of equilibria the economy can sustain, with implications for innovation, markups, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于搜索的并购理论，其中包含异质性企业和内生搜索互补性。利用该模型，我们探讨了并购激励、内生创新与企业规模分布之间的相互作用。我们推导了企业规模分布的动态规律，提供了闭式解，并求解了企业在内部创新和外部收购方面的投资决策。并购激励中的战略互补性可能产生多重均衡，包括一个高并购活动的不稳定均衡。因此，该模型为并购浪潮提供了新视角，将其视为有利基本面与协调效应相互作用，引发暂时性收购活动激增的时期。竞争政策既能影响均衡并购活动的水平，也能影响经济能够维持的均衡集合，这对创新、加成率和福利具有深远意义。
title: A search-based theory of merger waves
title_zh: 基于搜索的并购浪潮理论
